name: webext-bot
description: An open-source Github Bot to report extension size change and extension version change on pull requests.
author: Amit Singh <amitsingh5198@gmail.com>

scripts.simulate:issues.opened: pnpm build && GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=issues GITHUB_EVENT_PATH=test/fixtures/issues.opened.json probot receive dist/index.js
scripts.simulate:pull_request.opened: pnpm build && GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request GITHUB_EVENT_PATH=test/fixtures/pull_request.opened.json probot receive dist/index.js
scripts.simulate:pull_request.synchronize: pnpm build && GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request GITHUB_EVENT_PATH=test/fixtures/pull_request.synchronize.json probot receive dist/index.js
scripts.simulate:workflow_run.completed: pnpm build && GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=workflow_run GITHUB_EVENT_PATH=test/fixtures/workflow_run.completed.json probot receive dist/index.js
